claim_boundary: Primary evidence supports measuring realized skewness from intraday returns and testing it as a predecision distribution-shape variable. It does not establish a stable Bitcoin sign, the exact H1 estimator, a rolling percentile cutoff, or DRA entry economics. Exactly one separately frozen equal-capital historical screen may test whether admitting DRA entries only when the latest complete UTC day's realized skewness is not in the upper half of its own prior twenty-day distribution improves fee-adjusted economics and path risk. Feature redundancy or any frozen economic failure closes the exact family without changing estimator, lookback, relation or thresholds.

feature_contract.formula: For exactly twenty-four complete UTC-day H1 open-to-close log returns r_i, realized_skewness = sqrt(24) * sum(r_i^3) / sum(r_i^2)^(3/2); compare the latest value with exactly the prior twenty complete-day values using a midrank percentile.

prior_matrix.finding: The study uses intraday Bitcoin, Ethereum and Ripple prices and reports that realized skewness has statistically significant in-sample and out-of-sample predictive capability for subsequent cryptocurrency returns, with sensitivity varying across market states.
prior_matrix.identity: Ahmed and Al Mafrachi, Do higher-order realized moments matter for cryptocurrency returns?, International Review of Economics & Finance 72 (2021) 483-499
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Quantile-regression evidence across three cryptocurrencies does not establish the exact single-BTC H1 formula, a low-skew admission direction, thresholds, or DRA economics.

prior_matrix.finding: The Bitcoin study reports that conditional skewness predicts future returns, but the relationship is negative in its earlier subsample and positive during its later crisis subsample.
prior_matrix.identity: Atance and Serna, Time-varying expected returns, conditional skewness and Bitcoin return predictability, Quarterly Review of Economics and Finance 96 (2024) 101868
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: A parametric conditional-skewness timing strategy is not the same as nonparametric H1 realized skewness or DRA entry admission; the sign reversal requires annual breadth and neighbor gates rather than sign extrapolation.

prior_matrix.finding: The cross-sectional cryptocurrency study constructs daily realized moments from intraday returns and documents negative next-day return predictability for realized skewness, with extreme positive returns materially affecting the relation.
prior_matrix.identity: Liu, Li and Zeng, Higher moments, extreme returns, and cross-section of cryptocurrency returns, Finance Research Letters 39 (2021) 101536
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Cross-sectional long-short evidence over many cryptocurrencies does not prove time-series predictability for BTC, the exact percentile relation, or a matched-capital DRA veto.

prior_matrix.finding: A distribution-wide realized-performance measure is reported to dominate individual realized variance, skewness and kurtosis for predicting Bitcoin and Ethereum daily returns.
prior_matrix.identity: Yang, Chiu and Yen, Does the Realized Distribution-Based Measure Dominate Particular Moments? Evidence from Cryptocurrency Markets (2022 working paper)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The existing realized-performance DRA family is already closed; realized skewness must be demonstrably nonredundant before any economic result can be interpreted and cannot reopen that family.

real_time_design_requirements: Use exactly twenty-four H1 open-to-close log returns from the latest complete UTC day and execute no earlier than the unchanged next-bar open.
Require finite returns and strictly positive realized variance; missing or incomplete days fail closed.
Normalize only through the midrank percentile against exactly the prior twenty complete-day realized-skewness values.
Before economic interpretation, require absolute Spearman correlation at most 0.80 with both realized performance and intraday price-path efficiency in Design and Validation.
Keep DRA parent side, entries, exits, lot cost, capacity, fee, adverse slippage, cooldown and next-bar fill clock unchanged.
Freeze primary percentile 0.5 and neighbors 0.3 and 0.7 before outcome access; do not search another moment estimator, sampling interval, lookback, normalization, threshold or relation.

Require gate set V2 Design and Validation total and realized PnL improvement, annual breadth, drawdown and underwater non-inferiority, holding support, terminal inventory and neighbor stability; otherwise close the family.
Do not open post-2024 OOS or create a runtime rule from this prior audit.
uncertainty: No primary source directly validates this exact single-BTC H1 realized-skewness percentile DRA admission rule.
Published Bitcoin evidence reports time-varying or regime-dependent sign, so a fixed low-skew relation may fail across years.
H1 open-to-close sampling is coarser than the intraday frequencies used in much of the literature and may attenuate third-moment estimates.
Realized skewness may repackage the already closed realized-performance or price-path-efficiency families; the frozen correlation gate must close it before economics if so.
No strategy outcome, post-2024 evidence, OOS, candidate, runtime filter or Trading path was accessed while freezing this prior.
